# HierarchicalInferenceTopology

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A multi-level network architecture where each layer performs predictive coding, with top-down predictions and bottom-up error signals propagating through the topology. This concept directly informs TCC by mapping hierarchical inference onto physical network topologies, enabling scalable, modular neuromorphic designs that mimic cortical processing.
